name: Rathi Overlay
description: The event during which the slivers were transported to Urborg.

description_citations.text: "Sliver". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Overlay, many City of Traitors inhabitants are trapped in the shadow-world.
timeline.quote: many of the inhabitants of the City of Traitors , located at the heart of the Stronghold , were trapped in the shadow -world between worlds.

citation.text: "Vec", section "Vec". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Dal are transferred to Dominaria during the overlay.
timeline.quote: The Dal were transferred to Dominaria during the overlay.

citation.text: "Vec", section "Dal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Belbe begins a plan to cut flowstone production to prevent the Rathi Overlay.
timeline.quote: she also set in motion a plan to decrease flowstone production at the Stronghold

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rath is merged with Dominaria in the Rathi Overlay.
timeline.quote: during the invasion, it was merged with Dominaria in the so-called Rathi Overlay

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "First Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With the Rathi Overlay the Kor are brought to Dominaria; the il-Kor are trapped between planes.
timeline.quote: With the Rathi Overlay , the Kor were brought to Dominaria .

citation.text: "Kor", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Rathi Overlay brings Rath's Phyrexian legions onto Dominaria, and Crovax kills Tsabo Tavoc for failing at Koilos.
timeline.quote: Crovax killed Tsabo Tavoc as punishment for her failure at Koilos

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Second stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Rathi Overlay begins while the coalition recovers from the battle at Koilos; Urza's nine planeswalkers transport troops to key locations.
timeline.quote: The Rathi Overlay begins while the coalition forces are still recovering from the battle at Koilos .

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Rathi Overlay slivers are transported to Urborg, most dying and the rest killed in the Invasion.
timeline.quote: During the Rathi Overlay the slivers were transported to Urborg .

citation.text: "Sliver", section "Rathi Overlay". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Rathi overlay traps the City of Traitors and slivers between worlds.
timeline.quote: At the epicenter of the Rathi overlay, the City of Traitors did not align with Dominaria.

citation.text: Trespasser il-Vec (Time Spiral, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: During the Rathi Overlay, Freyalise overlays the Skyshroud Forest into Keld, opening another rift.
timeline.quote: Freyalise overlaid the Skyshroud Forest into Keld , opening yet another rift

citation.text: "Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Causes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dominaria faces the First Phyrexian Invasion, including the Rathi Overlay, which broadens Dominarians' understanding of other planes.
timeline.quote: In 4205 A.R., Dominaria faced the First Phyrexian Invasion , including the Rathi Overlay where the artificial plane of Rath was transplanted on top of Dominaria.

citation.text: "Plane", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rath is overlaid on Dominaria, delivering Phyrexia's legions onto Dominarian soil and devastating regions.
timeline.quote: Jagged spires of flowstone overwrote entire regions of Dominaria

citation.text: "Rathi Overlay", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
